games.name: Bubble Hockey
new: Players are plain cylinders for now: the white wedge shows which way he's facing, the stick points at the puck
With the puck, your thumb sets where the puck goes and he pivots around it - skate in, circle, tap to shoot. He picks his own facing and shields the puck from checkers (harder to poke)
Livelier boards, a heavier puck (one or two small hops), gentle stickhandling, and the player you hold gently pulls a nearby loose puck in
